title: Settings checksum is an additive u8 sum of 3 payload bytes — sum-preserving corruption deserializes as silently-wrong settings (still present since round 1)
detail: Any corruption that preserves the byte sum (e.g. palette +1 with motion -1 mod 256) passes the checksum and the range checks, yielding wrong-but-valid persisted settings instead of the defaults fallback. Low impact: single-player local dotfile, not an attacker boundary, and all range checks still hold.
recommended_fix: Swap the additive sum for a CRC8 or FNV-1a byte over the payload; same cost, catches sum-preserving multi-byte corruption.
